rooms.name: Antechamber
rooms.description: A stone threshold under the arch. Pale daylight fails a few steps in, and the passage beyond is black.

approach.description: A worn dirt path ends at a weathered stone arch. Thin clouds cross a pale blue sky, and pale sun falls between dead trees on the parched ground. Beyond the pass, scrub and dead trees follow the path until a mountain range meets it.

vista.description: Scrub and dead trees follow a long dirt path away from the pass until the mountain range meets it.
